reviews.comment: be ready to read. a lot of the class is old English that has to be translated, so the content is difficult, but as long as you ask questions and participate in class you will be fine

reviews.comment: I can't say enough good things about Ms. Perry! Her passion for English is definitely shown in every lecture and gives fantastic feedbacks if you go to her office hours. A LOT of books need to be read in a ver short time, and your papers are typically pretty lengthy. She never gives out low grades, but if you want a 95+ on papers yougotta work hard

Great professor! SO many readings though, I never seemed to be able to catch up. Four papers, all doable and she was rlly nice when grading. She seems to really care about students and works with your schedule if you ask! Takes attendance daily but lets you do zoom if u have a valid excuse.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Caring
